blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. How many whole numbers are not solutions of x plus four is less than three, or two x minus three is greater than three?
Solve each part on its own. X plus four is less than three, so x is less than negative one. Two x minus three is greater than three, so two x is greater than six, and x is greater than three.
The whole numbers in the gap are left out, and both circles are open: negative one, zero, one, two and three. That is five numbers.
Watch out for these traps. If you treat the open circles as closed, you get three. If you subtract the boundaries, you get four.
